SHUTDOWN = UPDATE! ✅
Leaderboards reset every 30 minutes to prevent performance issues!

Welcome to [IRM] MotoGP25! 
A new, and innovative experience designed specifically to simulate the high speeds of Motorbike racing!
If you enjoy, please like the game!
Please join the communications server!

Press L for timings! 🏁
Press V for first person camera! 📷

- NEW 2021 Bikes!
- NEW Mobile Controls!
- RESETTING CHARACTER BUG FIX!

This game is primarily made to be played on PC or Mobile. The game will still work for console players but some UI elements may not work as intended.
